notes: MIT OpenCourseWare (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). OCW links "(PDF)" to an HTML resource page that holds the file, hence maxDepth 1.
courses.maths.ox.ac.uk is a Moodle LMS and its robots.txt disallows /pluginfile.php/, where the course PDFs live, so it is not crawled.
davidtong.org is David Tong's (DAMTP) own site. damtp/user/examples holds the Tripos example sheets.

Princeton course pages (Prywes MAT 201 lecture notes, MAT 215, MAT 320, FRS; A. Chang MAT 215 homework; Fick MAT 204; Johnson MAT 202B old exams), each linking ~5-22 PDFs. Page links use www.math.princeton.edu, which 301-redirects to web.math.princeton.edu. Skipped: ~rvan/ home page (mixes lecture notes with research papers and talks), ~aionescu and ~aaa and ~ssaid (403), ~smorel and ~jkileel (moved away). web.math robots.txt only disallows /math_alive/ problem pages.
math.stanford.edu and virtualmath1.stanford.edu serve an incomplete TLS chain, so Node cannot fetch them (they show up as "disallowed by robots.txt").
Some faculty pages (e.g. ~hutching, ~wodzicki) answer 403 to the crawler.

Several www.ma.imperial.ac.uk/~user pages answer 403 to the crawler. D. Turaev's Mathematical Methods for Physics page (lecture notes, problem sheets with answers, past exams; ~40 PDFs) and E. McCoy's ISE 2 Probability and Statistics page (notes, past papers with solutions; ~9 PDFs). Blocked with 403: ~prodrigu (Rodriguez MATH50006 notes), ~abuchan, ~jmb, ~ahaydon, ~ebrowne, ~kcollins, ~kb514. www.ma.imperial.ac.uk/robots.txt returns 403, so robots could not be checked. Skipped github.io course sites (finite-element.github.io, comp-lin-alg.github.io) because they are org-hosted, not faculty-named.

www.math.nus.edu.sg is behind an Incapsula JS wall (not attempted). Seeds are NUS maths faculty pages on other NUS hosts: Frank Stephan's (Maths/CS joint) MA5219/MA3205/MA3219/MA6219 course pages on www.comp.nus.edu.sg (lecture-note books plus weekly homework PDFs), and blog.nus.edu.sg teaching pages of Wong Yan Loi, Timo Sprekeler, Qianxiao Li, De-Qi Zhang and Weizhu Bao. blog.nus.edu.sg PDF links 302-redirect to bpb-us-w2.wpmucdn.com (200 application/pdf) and its robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 30.
metaphor.ethz.ch (course pages) answers 403 to the crawler. Many D-MATH scripts are in German and are skipped by the language check.
Most Sorbonne course material is in French. webusers.imj-prg.fr answered 403 from the crawl container; retry from another network.
Yau Mathematical Sciences Center lecture series. Few English course notes are published on Tsinghua hosts.

Guo Chuan Thiang (BICMR) English course pages (Analysis I, quantum theory, infinity categories, math physics, differential topology) with weekly lecture notes, exercises and assignments (~15-20 PDFs each); Wenyuan Yang (BICMR) geometric group theory, hyperbolic manifolds/geometry and surfaces pages with his own English notes and exercise sheets (some pages also link third-party PDFs such as Miller, Bass-Serre, Warwick, Brown, so crawler should filter by host). www.math.pku.edu.cn/en/ resets the connection and www.math.pku.edu.cn fails TLS from this container, though math.pku.edu.cn (no www) works; Yuan Yao's math.pku.edu.cn/teachers/yaoy pages were rejected (mostly third-party readings, many dead links), Tian Zhiyu's pages (Chinese exams, third-party Zinger notes) and Huang Dezheng / Wen Zaiwen pages (Chinese) were also skipped. Yiwen Ding's homepage (bicmr.pku.edu.cn/~dingyiwen/) has English nt1.pdf and nt2.pdf number theory notes but is mixed with research papers, so not seeded.
Most EPFL course material sits on moodle.epfl.ch (deny-listed).

IMO Orsay faculty pages with English M2 material: Paulin (English TD/DM sheets for M2 AAG ergodic theory, dynamics, groups and geometry; the main notes are in French), Curien (English probability lecture notes), Moreau (English M2 representation theory and Lie algebra notes and problems; her homepage also lists a few research PDFs), Giraud (M1 Mathematics for AI notes), Nonnenmacher (semiclassical analysis notes; the rest is French) and Harari's teaching index (depth 1 into per-course subpages, e.g. the English M2 Brauer group notes and exam). No robots.txt on the IMO host. Pansu, Thomine, Le Gall and Massot are French-only. Léautaud's site (leautaud.perso.math.cnrs.fr) was skipped because it is mostly research papers. No usable LMV or ENS Paris-Saclay pages were found.
www.math.caltech.edu (term course pages) was unreachable from the crawl container.
